parameters.content:
## Scrape Shopify & WooCommerce Store Emails, Tech Stack & Exact Stock to Google Sheets
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Shopify & WooCommerce Scraper: Products, Stock & Store Leads](https://apify.com/storeintel/ecommerce-store-intelligence-scraper)

Automatically enrich a list of Shopify or WooCommerce store domains with verified contact emails, social links, 30+ detected pixels/apps (Klaviyo, Meta Pixel, TikTok, Judge.me, Gorgias), and exact variant inventory.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [Shopify Store Email, Tech Stack & Exact Inventory Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-store-email-tech-stack-exact-inventory-scraper)
- [WooCommerce & Shopify Product Price & Discount Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/woocommerce-product-price-inventory-scraper)
- [Shopify Judge.me, Okendo & Yotpo Product Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-judgeme-loox-yotpo-reviews-scraper)
